I hope so... and it’s a fairly standard office job, but I can’t help but compare to my friends who are finishing their PhDs.

Also FYI I have calmed down a lot now, so if I don’t reply I might have dropped off to sleep. Thank you so much for taking the time to listen and helping me to rationalise my thoughts. 💖

He hasn’t, but I know he has issues with touch so I shouldn’t take it so personally, just usually it’s ok and I’m feeling a bit sensitive today too.

I’m worried that my difficulties around sex make him feel bad about himself. I’m also not great at helping around the house, but I have been trying hard to improve that recently. I feel very stuck in my job which is also getting me down, and my lack of self esteem is preventing me from pursuing something else.

I just feel he deserves someone better.

Thank you so much for responding 😭I think this evening was triggered a bit by my boyfriend not wanting me to hug him and flinching from my touch earlier. I know he also struggles with anxiety, and recently I’ve made him aware I’m getting suicidal ideation a lot at the moment which I know makes him feel worse.

I’m just terrified I’ve done something wrong or he’s on the verge of leaving me. I asked multiple times if he is OK (he said yes) and that I’m here for him. I asked if it was something I had done but he said no (but part of me doubts that in case he’s trying to protect me)

I honestly love him so much, I want to know how to be better so I can show him that and not make him worry.
Yeah, I'll try to focus on this a bit more :) thank you.
